title: Cattle mutilations in the Bigelow era

tellings.quote: uh during the Bigelow era, you know, my predecessor, they did have many cattle mutilation events where

plain: Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property long tied to reports of strange events, had many cattle mutilations, cases of cattle found dead and cut in unexplained ways, while it was owned by Robert Bigelow between the mid-1990s and 2016. Brandon Fugal, who calls Bigelow his predecessor at the ranch, tells Michels this as a summary, pointing to necropsy reports, that is, animal autopsies, kept in the Bigelow years and to a Dr. O'nett, without quoting from them. If true, the ranch's strange history includes physical evidence on paper.
